issue.title: v2.0.0-dev84858: Vector::Reference used on vector of different type (source INTEGER[] referenced INTEGER)
issue.body:
### What happens?

We see this internal error with latest v2.0-cyanoptera. I didn't see a similar report.

### To Reproduce

```sql
CREATE TABLE t1 (c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER[]);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, NULL), (2, NULL);

UPDATE t1 SET c2 = s3.a1
FROM (
    SELECT t1.c1                   AS a0,
           max(s1.v1)              AS a1,
           max(t1.c1)::BIGINT      AS a2,
           count(DISTINCT t1.c1)   AS a3
    FROM t1
    JOIN (SELECT c1 AS k1, [c1] AS v1 FROM t1) AS s1 ON (t1.c1 = s1.k1)
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT c1 FROM t1)          AS s2 ON (t1.c1 = s2.c1)
    GROUP BY t1.c1
) AS s3
WHERE t1.c1 = s3.a0;

```
